node_how_windows: run persona-link install --personad <path to personad.exe> to install the scheduled task that starts at sign-in (docs/operations/windows.md)
node_how_darwin: use Install Resident Node Service in the Persona Link menu bar app, or run persona-link node install
node_how_linux: run persona-link node install (systemd user service)
pin_mismatch: The TLS public-key fingerprint differs from pairing; this isn't the same hub
proxy_invalid: The outbound proxy setting is not a usable http:// or https:// proxy URL
proxy_tls_failed: The outbound proxy's certificate is not trusted
proxy_tls_handshake: The outbound proxy did not complete TLS (check that it is an https:// proxy)
proxy_connect_failed: The outbound proxy did not open a connection to the hub
proxy_rejected: The outbound proxy refused to connect to the hub (HTTP {status})
proxy_only_none: Proxy-only mode is on, but no outbound proxy is set for the hub's addresses
proxy_always_needs_url: Save a proxy URL first (persona-link proxy <url> --always): a service rarely has HTTPS_PROXY or ALL_PROXY
proxy_always_ssh_always: SSH-only mode is set: turn it off first with persona-link ssh --no-always
ssh_always_proxy_always: Proxy-only mode is set: turn it off first with persona-link proxy --no-always
repaired: Paired again; reconnecting with the new credentials
direct_ready: A direct address is reachable; switching back to it
credential_refused: The hub rejected this computer's credentials (they may have been revoked): pair again
replaced: This computer opened another link elsewhere (are two Persona Link instances using the same credentials?)
credential_revoked: The credentials were revoked: pair again
heartbeat_timeout: The hub didn't answer the heartbeat: {error}
heartbeat_after_network_change: The hub didn't answer after the network changed: {error}
network_address_gone: The network changed and the original local address is gone
no_candidates: No hub addresses to try: pair again, or add one with persona-link address add
hello_refused: The hub rejected this computer's hello (machine id and credentials don't match)
hostname_mismatch: certificate hostname doesn't match (system certificate validation)
certificate_untrusted: certificate not trusted by the system (system certificate validation)
pair_link_invalid: This isn't a pairing link from personad hub pair (persona://link?… or persona://pair?…)
pair_token_missing: The pairing link has no token
pair_pin_without_tls: The pairing link has a fingerprint but no TLS port: run personad hub pair --machine on the hub again
pair_tls_required: This hub has no TLS (public.tls_listen in hub.json), and public_url isn't an HTTPS reverse proxy: computer links require HTTPS
pair_no_addresses: The pairing link has no hub address
pair_machine_mismatch: This pairing link is for {expected}, not {actual}
pair_machine_required: Enter this computer's machine id on the hub (the entry with kind link in hub.json)
hub_no_credential: The hub returned no Link credentials: upgrade the hub
address_https_required: {address} isn't an HTTPS address: Link uses only the hub's TLS port
running: Another Persona Link is already running on this computer
listen_invalid: Invalid listen address {address}: use :18663 or address:port
listen_port_invalid: Listen address {address} has an invalid port
listen_host_invalid: Listen address {address} must use this computer's IP (or only a port to listen on every address)
address_port_required: Address {address} needs a port (the listening port isn't known)
address_invalid: Invalid address {address}: use a domain, IP, or address:port
address_zone: Address {address} includes an interface (%…): other computers can't use it
no_local_address: No local address the hub can reach (only loopback, tunnel, or temporary addresses): use --addr, such as --addr this-computer.example.com
connector_link_invalid: This isn't a link from persona-link pair --listen (persona://connector?…)
connector_link_incomplete: The link is incomplete: addr, fp, and code are required
mode_invalid: Mode must be {active} (connect to the hub) or {passive} (let the hub connect)
listen_in_use: the port is already in use
listen_address_missing: this computer doesn't have that address
config_incomplete: {path} is incomplete: pair again with persona-link pair
